messages:
morgan: FYI we just received a 50+ Q security questionnaire from BigBank. Their primary asks are tenant-level envelope proofs, per-tenant RBAC change history (12 months), real-time audit streaming to their SIEM, and documented KMS rotation + incident-playbook. Can eng-security own answers and a minimal artifact set for the review call? Need this before Tues.

anuj: I can take lead on artifacts. Can we itemize owners: KMS rotation proof (ash?), audit export (katie), RBAC change history (me), live streaming architecture (phil)?

katie: We already have per-tenant audit exports to s3 (wrapped with KMS). The "envelope proof" ask is ambiguous — do they want key metadata + rotation events, or full HSM attestation/cert? Hosted vs Private differ. :eyes:

phil: For hosted we can provide rotation events + signed metadata and the key protocol diagram. For private/on-prem we can provide customer HSM attestation material. We should clarify with BigBank which they expect.

ash: I'll produce a small runbook and an export example. Plan: one tarball with rotation.json, key-metadata.json, and signer-cert.pem. ETA EOD today for a draft.

sec-bot: Automated notice: last rotation events for prod-KMS-tenant-bigbank available at s3://evidence/rotations/tenant-bigbank/2026-03-15-rotation.json

katie: Also they asked for RBAC change history queryable by tenant id. We store change events in ES. Quick sample query to produce CSV: 
```
GET /_search?q=tenant_id:bigbank AND event:rbac_change&size=10000
```
We can include a redacted CSV extract.

anuj: Legal will want redaction. Also question on separation-of-duties: they requested proof that a single engineer can't both rotate keys and push RBAC changes. We have console approval flows and github PR approvals — need concrete logs tying approver ids to events.

phil: We can stitch rotation events (who initiated) with the PR audit for RBAC. Example: rotation event contains initiator_id and signature, PR contains approver_id and timestamp. I'll draft the correlation example.

morgan: For "live streaming" to customer SIEM — we support webhook and Kafka forwarding. Need to confirm supported throughput, guaranteed ordering, and how to provide an endpoint for BigBank (TLS mutual auth?).

ash: On streaming: we have a connector that supports mTLS and can buffer up to 10k events/min per tenant before backpressure. I'll capture the SLA/limits and sample config.

katie: Starting a slide deck with sections: artifact list, key custody diagram, RBAC query samples, streaming options, incident playbook. Google slide draft: https://docs.google.com/example-redwood-bigbank (placeholder) :thumbsup:

ash: Runbook snippet I'll include in artifacts:
```
# export rotation proof
redwood-cli audit export --tenant bigbank --range 2025-03-01:2026-03-20 --out rotations-bigbank.tar.gz
s3 cp rotations-bigbank.tar.gz s3://evidence/tenant-bigbank/
# verify signature
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify signer-pub.pem -signature rotation.sig rotation.json
```
Will include verification steps and expected filenames.

anuj: Q — do we have an auditable proof of key rotation sequence (hash chain)? They want to ensure rotation history is immutable.

phil: We can provide rotation events with incremental sequence numbers and an HMAC chain in the rotation metadata. For hosted tenants we sign each event server-side; include method in the doc.

morgan: Also include our incident response outline for key compromise. They specifically asked for timeline and responsibilities. High level: detect, isolate, revoke, rotate, notify, forensic replay. Ash, can you draft the triage playbook bullets?

ash: Yes. Proposed triage steps: - Detect via anomaly alerts - Isolate tenant resources and disable new inferences - Revoke affected envelope keys and issue replacements - Re-run audit export to reconstruct affected window - Provide signed rotation + revocation proof and remediation timeline. Will add expected delivery SLAs and contact points. ETA tomorrow morning.

katie: One more ask from them: proof that audit logs are tamper-evident. We can supply signed daily digests (hash chain) and S3 object versioning metadata as extra proof. I'll add that to slides.

morgan: Good. Can we get a minimal artifact checklist to hand over now? Suggest: 1) rotations-bigbank.tar.gz (rotation.json, key-metadata.json, rotation.sig), 2) rbac-history.csv (redacted), 3) architecture diagram (key custody + streaming), 4) incident-playbook.pdf, 5) sample streaming config + SLA.

anuj: I'll produce rbac-history.csv with reviewer notes. Phil — can you collect the PR link examples for separation-of-duties?

phil: Yep, will redact and include example IDs.

morgan: Deadline: artifacts + slide draft by Monday 09:00 PST. Review call with BigBank Tuesday 10:00 PST. I'll book the calendar and include an agenda: quick 15m artifacts walkthrough, 30m technical Q&A, 15m next steps.

katie: I'll be on the call and will share the slide link when ready.

ash: I'll join and walk through the rotation proof and playbook.

anuj: I'll cover the RBAC history export and separation-of-duties correlation.

morgan: Thanks all — please add any blockers in this thread. :rocket:
